why: removes 3 mixin injection handler(s): check each still applies somewhere, with the same effect
reviewed: (26.3, re-derived from the 26.3 sources and javap -p -c, not inherited; #32) Each handler the authors had has a 26.3 home with 1.21.1's effect. renderClouds HEAD: 26.3 has no clouds pass; executeClassicTransparency (CustomCloudsRenderer.renderClouds, else CloudRenderer.render) and executeOit (renderCloudsOit, else CloudRenderer.renderOit) each draw clouds only when the cloud status is on and ARGB.alpha(cloudColor) > 0, so two @ModifyExpressionValue (require = 1) make that alpha 0 while CloudGate.occlude is set: the custom renderer and vanilla's are both skipped, on both transparency paths (the overridden 26.3 CloudRendererMixin only reached vanilla's). renderEntity: the EntityRenderDispatcher.submit @Redirect in submitEntities sets the occlusion flag; submitFeatures runs at the top of render(), before the frame graph is built, so the flag is final before the main pass runs. renderSky TAIL: AfterSky is posted only inside lambda$addSkyPass$0, which render() does not add when shouldRenderSky is false and addSkyPass does not add for lava / powder snow, doesMobEffectBlockSky or Skybox NONE, and it is posted even after a custom renderSky returned true; so the skybox has its own frame pass on targets.main injected before addMainPass (26.3 descriptor (FrameGraphBuilder, PreparedFrame, GpuBufferSlice, ChunkSectionsToRender, boolean); require = 1), sets the terrain fog render() gives the sky and main passes, is skipped when the @ModifyExpressionValue on renderSky (now taking the sky fog) saw true, and GlobalSkyboxHook.passOwned makes the AfterSky handler stand down. The PoseStack starts from identity because render() pushes viewRotationMatrix onto the model-view stack the helpers upload. Depth: 26.3 clears depth to 0.0 and Projection swaps near/far (reverse-Z), the helpers' default compare is GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL, so the skybox draws everywhere in the frustum; the texture skybox writes no depth. extractVisibleEntities moved to LevelExtractor (inherited LevelExtractorMixin). renderLevel's HEAD/RETURN handlers target 26.3's render(allocator, outline, cameraState, fog, fogColor, renderSky, consistentDepth). New on 26.3 (#33): a flag around submitFeatures that net.eca.mv.SubmitPhase reads, because 26.3 submits before the clear pass.
